value.rationale: The source device has a demonstrated positive short discharge interval. The new two-limit paradox and exact \(\Delta^2\) cutoff quantify when keeping the thermal load attached reverses net delivered work; this is a physically meaningful cycle-design stopping-time boundary, not an arbitrary small-sample invariant. The sharp coefficient depends on measurable charged populations and the load Fermi offset, and the source simulation endpoint lies orders of magnitude before the predicted late crossover.
